flags.reason: The Bottom Nav Item guide (31f1c5e) and its evidence were checked on 24 September 2026 on jfs-components 0.1.60 (its Sources note says “Declared, installed, and npm latest are all jfs-components@0.1.60.”); the installed package is 0.1.78 (mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02). BottomNav.tsx is the same blob at the 0.1.60 release and on dbe0e02, and BottomNavItem.tsx changed once since 0.1.60 (the label's line height now goes through safeTextLineHeight, still 14 px), so every sentence this entry quotes still holds, but these do not, and the entry leaves them out: (1) the Sources note's “The guide stays in Light mode, matching the Figma context, because the installed Dark tokens resolve the Idle label to orange.”: with Color Mode Dark the Idle label now resolves to rgb(241, 241, 241), a light grey (mode/Grey/400 Dark, fixed for #177 in 636f3f5). (2) The Anatomy Item note's “Hugs its content on its own.” and the Sizing description's “On its own, an item is as wide as its label.” (and its card “Width follows the label”) hold only in the guide's inline-flex frame: the item's root has alignItems center and no width (BottomNavItem.tsx lines 79–82), so a parent that stretches its children widens it (Storybook's Default story draws a standalone Home item 992 px wide). Also unclear: In context's “… and keeps exactly one Active.” and its caption “Choose a destination. BottomNav marks it Active and the screen above changes.”: BottomNav keeps no state; it calls onChange with the pressed item's value and draws Active from the value the screen passes back, so a value that matches no item leaves every item Idle (BottomNav.tsx lines 99–119), as the Bottom Nav guide says (“Bottom Nav only reports which destination was pressed.”). And the guide doesn't say when not to use a Bottom Nav Item, so avoidWhen is empty. On the web, the item's dark 2 px focus line (States: “Keyboard focus adds a dark 2 px line under the item …”) also appears after a mouse press and stays until focus moves on, though the browser doesn't treat that focus as keyboard focus (not :focus-visible): the item sets its focus style on every focus event (BottomNavItem.tsx lines 46, 203–206 and 226) and doesn't use Coin's own keyboard-only check (isKeyboardInputModality, web-platform-utils.ts lines 233–271). Published Storybook draws the same after a click on a Bottom Nav tab. Re-check the guide on 0.1.78 and publish it, then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r26, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #556; the focus line after a mouse press is Component Bug #555.
